mapper.select: SELECT cmt_id AS cmtId, cmt_parent AS cmtParent, cmt_text AS cmtText, cmt_create_date AS cmtCreateDate, pst_id AS pstId, like_cnt AS likeCount FROM cmt WHERE pst_id = #{pstId} ORDER BY cmt_create_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmt(cmt_parent, cmt_text, cmt_create_date, mb_id, pst_id, like_cnt) VALUES(1, #{cmtText}, now(), 1, #{pstId}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE cmt SET cmt_text = #{cmtText}, mb_id = 1, cmt_parent=1, pst_id = #{pstId}, cmt_create_date = now() WHERE cmt_id = #{cmtId}
mapper.select: SELECT lk_id AS lkId, cmt_id AS cmtId, mb_id AS mbId FROM `like` WHERE cmt_id = #{cmtId} AND mb_id = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `like` WHERE cmt_id = #{cmtId} AND mb_id = 1
